surface_mount.installation_DESIGN: TC junction spot-welded to a 4 x 4 x 0.05 mm 304 SS shim; 25 um polyimide film between shim and the 6061 case OD (electrical isolation: the MAX31856 needs a floating TC, BIAS to T-, DS Note 6); high-temperature filled adhesive both sides (>= 200 C continuous rating: soak 190.9 C SIM); 0.25 mm glass-braid K leads anchored 15 mm along the hoop isotherm, then strain-relieved; no connector (continuous Class 1 wire to J605 / J606)
